head_commit.message:
Implement turn-scoped hook interrupts

Treat PermissionRequest deny{interrupt:true} as a request to abort the current turn instead of firing a detached session interrupt. The running task now owns final TurnAborted emission after it unwinds, while external aborts still claim finalization synchronously so follow-up work cannot start early and existing interrupt paths stay deterministic.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
